description: Pure offline paired statistics; no run-directory or card comparability claim. Cells and taxonomy are sorted deterministically. Taxonomy counts are run-local, with excluded rows in a separate column. Comparison exclusions use either paired row. No scored samples produce null estimates rather than a zero effect.

aa.description: q0 counts scored pairs differing in score or failure class, matching the flip list. Wilson 95% endpoints in ppm use z squared = 3.841458820694124, radius rounded outward at 10^12 precision, then endpoints outward to ppm; no scored items gives null q0 and [0,1000000].

comparison.description: Mean of within-life mean paired differences, current minus previous (A minus A prime for the band). Two-sided sign-flip p uses nonzero lives; no scored lives gives null estimate and p. Interval is the 95% t-calibrated wild cluster bootstrap, available at 10 contributing lives.

estimate.description: Exact fraction in score units (score_milli / 1000), or probability units for p and q0; milli is fraction times 1000 rounded half to even.

sensitivity.description: Approximate MDE = 2.80 * sample standard deviation / sqrt(L), using n-1. Compute the combined root exactly with integer isqrt, truncate down to 1/1000000 score units, then round milli half to even.
